title: Dumbbell goblet squat
instructions: Hold one dumbbell vertically close to your chest.
Stand with feet around shoulder-width apart and brace gently.
Sit your hips down and back while keeping your whole foot planted.
Stand up by pushing the floor away and finish tall without leaning back.
form_cues: Keep knees tracking in the same direction as toes.
Use a comfortable depth; quality beats depth.
regressions: Squat to a chair as a depth target.
progressions: Add a small amount of weight once all reps are controlled.
Pause for one second at the bottom.

title: Dumbbell Romanian deadlift
instructions: Hold dumbbells in front of your thighs and stand tall.
Soften your knees, then push your hips backwards as the weights travel close to your legs.
Stop when you feel a comfortable stretch in the back of your thighs without rounding your back.
Drive your hips forward to stand tall.
form_cues: Keep the weights close to your body.
Think hips back rather than squat down.
regressions: Use lighter dumbbells or an unloaded hip hinge.
progressions: Use a slower three-second lowering phase.

title: Dumbbell floor press
instructions: Lie on your back with knees bent and one dumbbell in each hand.
Hold upper arms at roughly 45 degrees from your body.
Press the dumbbells up until your arms are straight without locking hard.
Lower under control until your upper arms lightly touch the floor.
form_cues: Keep ribs relaxed rather than arching hard.
regressions: Use a wall press-up if getting to the floor is unsuitable.
progressions: Add one or two reps per set before adding load.

title: One-arm dumbbell row
instructions: Support one hand on a sturdy bench or chair and hold the dumbbell in the other.
Keep your torso steady and pull the dumbbell toward your ribs.
Pause briefly with your elbow behind you.
Lower slowly and complete the reps before changing sides.
form_cues: Keep shoulder away from your ear.
Avoid twisting your torso to lift the weight.

title: Resistance-band Pallof press
instructions: Anchor a resistance band securely at chest height and stand side-on to it.
Hold the band at your chest with both hands and step away until there is light tension.
Brace gently and press your hands straight out without letting your torso rotate.
Return to your chest slowly and repeat before swapping sides.
form_cues: Keep hips and shoulders facing forward.
Use only enough band tension to control the movement.
progressions: Pause with arms extended for two seconds.

title: Low step-up
instructions: Use a stable low step and stand close to it.
Place one whole foot on the step.
Push through that foot to bring yourself up under control.
Step down carefully and complete the reps before swapping sides.
form_cues: Keep the working knee tracking over the foot.
Use a rail or wall lightly for balance if available.
progressions: Use a slightly higher step if comfortable.
Hold light dumbbells once bodyweight reps are easy.

title: Lat pulldown
instructions: Set the thigh pad so you are secure and choose a manageable weight.
Grip the bar a little wider than shoulder-width and sit tall.
Pull the bar toward the top of your chest while driving elbows down.
Return the bar slowly until arms are long without letting the weight stack slam.
form_cues: Keep chest tall without leaning far backwards.
Do not pull the bar behind your neck.
progressions: Increase weight gradually once all reps are smooth.

title: Incline treadmill walk
instructions: Start at an easy walking pace for two minutes.
Increase the incline gradually while keeping a pace you can control without hanging on the rails.
Work at a purposeful effort where you can still speak in short sentences.
Reduce the incline and pace for the final two minutes.
form_cues: Stay tall and use the rails only briefly for balance.
Choose speed and incline that keep your stride controlled.
progressions: Add one or two minutes before increasing incline.
Increase incline slightly while keeping the same controlled pace.
